items.title: Line item
clues: I am a set of instructions.
I say what to deliver, when and to whom.
Priority, dates and targeting are settings on me.
items.why: A line item holds the delivery rules for part of a campaign.

items.title: Ad tag
clues: I am a small piece of code.
I sit on the page where an ad should show.
The ad comes back because of me.
items.why: The ad tag asks the ad server for an ad.

items.title: Creative
clues: I am what the viewer sees.
I can be an image, a video or code.
I belong to a line item.
Different sizes of me may be needed for different slots.
items.why: The creative is the ad itself.
